note: A strict build over register 1 (#1736). Owners a and b of variable 5 share the source name 'Svar' and take their operational definitions: 'Svar — Patienter' and 'Svar — Personal'. Variable 6's own source name is 'Svar — Patienter', so the ladder's name for a collides with a variable outside its group. The uniqueness check runs over the whole variant: a and c are refused, b is not.
fails_if: the uniqueness check stops at the ladder's groups (a and c both publish 'Svar — Patienter' and the strict build completes), or the ladder renames c, which carries no shared source name

sources.description: Variable 5, named 'Svar', delivers A (CVID 21, 'Patienter') and B (CVID 22, 'Personal'); variable 6, named 'Svar — Patienter', delivers C (CVID 23). All in edition 2020.
